text: Records must not be altered, so that the audit trail is complete.
The process shall be validated where the results cannot be fully verified.
Electronic signatures must be linked to their respective electronic records to ensure that the signatures cannot be excised, copied, or otherwise transferred.
The manufacturer shall ensure that devices are not adulterated.
The manufacturer must not ship devices that are adulterated.
The procedure is designed to ensure that the signature cannot be excised.
